This post by @michaeljknowles is an excellent example of synonymous parallelism, a poetic technique often found in the Bible, where the same thing is stated two different ways, as in "Pride goes before destruction/a haughty spirit before a fall." From Knowles we get: "It's an account by news media outlets./It does not correspond to the truth in any way." Same statement, different words. A lesson in literature.
